verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage offers payment screening and transaction monitoring, so pre-built commerce and PSP connectors are a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows only a raw REST API, Postman collection, OpenAPI schema, webhooks and a batch API. None of the cited docs mention maintained integrations for Shopify, Salesforce Commerce, BigCommerce or any payment service provider. Developer building blocks do not count as maintained integrations.
